metadata.name: Blood Gulch
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A long grassy box canyon walled in by sheer rock, with two squat concrete bunkers facing each other from the far ends: Red holds the north, Blue the south. Each bunker keeps its flag behind the dais on the ground floor, a sniper rifle on its roof deck (open stairs at the front corners, a long ramp up the back) and a buggy, a gun jeep, two speeders, a tank and a skyfighter on the apron. A jump pad beside each base throws you onto the 10 m sniper ledge along the far side cliff; each ledge also has a ramp at one end. Rolling grass, boulders, rock outcrops by the cliffs and bushes to hide in fill the floor; rockets wait on the knoll in the middle. A layout homage to the classic two-base canyon of 2001.
